# Brooklyn SolarWorks

> Brooklyn SolarWorks provides residential and commercial solar panel installations across NYC, specializing in innovative Brooklyn Solar Canopy systems for flat roofs, brownstones, and rooftop living spaces.

BSW serves Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, and surrounding NYC boroughs with custom solar solutions designed for urban environments. The company helps homeowners and businesses navigate NYC solar incentives including the NYC Property Tax Abatement, New York State Solar Tax Credit, and Con Edison net metering programs.

## Key Topics

- Brooklyn Solar Canopy
- NYC solar incentives
- NYC Property Tax Abatement
- New York State Solar Tax Credit
- Con Edison net metering
- Flat roof solar installations
- Rooftop solar canopies
- Climate Mobilization Act compliance
- NYC fire code compliance
- Residential solar NYC
- Commercial solar NYC
- Tilt rack systems
- Landmarked homes solar
- Brooklyn brownstone solar
- TSRF analysis

- [Guide to New York City Commercial Solar Incentives](https://brooklynsolarworks.com/blog/new-york-city-commercial-solar-incentives): NYC commercial solar incentives: Local Laws 92, 94, 97 compliance guide
